subject.title: Feature request: auto-update for skills and plugins

question: Should OpenClaw add unattended auto-update for installed ClawHub skills and plugins, and what trust, pinning, rollback, audit, and operator-control policy must gate it?
rationale: The requested capability downloads and applies third-party code in the background and adds public config plus gateway lifecycle behavior, so automation cannot safely choose the permanent security and UX boundary.

options.title: Design gated opt-in updater
options.body: Define a default-off updater with provenance checks, installPolicy integration, pinning or rollback, audit logs, and failure handling before implementation.

options.title: Keep explicit updates only
options.body: Leave `openclaw skills update` and `openclaw plugins update` as the supported path and document external scheduling for operators who accept the risk.

options.title: Split prerequisites first
options.body: Track signing, rollback, provenance, and update safety as prerequisite work before deciding on background automation.

recommendation.title: Design gated opt-in updater
recommendation.body: Define a default-off updater with provenance checks, installPolicy integration, pinning or rollback, audit logs, and failure handling before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the strongest combined history across package auto-update, plugin update behavior, and ClawHub fallback boundaries.
